findings.headline: This assertion runs before the DOM and effects see setSize on line 25.
findings.why: In Solid 2.0.3 a setter queues its write, and rendered DOM, effects and memos update when the batch flushes in a microtask or flush() runs. Solid 1.x applied the write and its DOM updates at once outside batch, so this test checked the new state.
findings.guidance: Import flush from solid-js and call flush() after the write, before the assertion; that is what flush is for in tests. If the test awaits something after the write instead, the microtask has run and no flush is needed.
